summary: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting board and committee changes following resignations of directors Michael Howe and Donald Hunter, effective August 31, 2026. The board appointed William Levy and Jonathan Ip to the Audit Committee, with Bruce Linton as chair, and later to the Compensation Committee with Levy as chair. The resignations appear abrupt, forcing committee reconstitution. Independence and financial expertise determinations were made under Nasdaq rules. This is an internal governance event without deal terms, stake disclosures, or transaction structure. Watch for further departures or strategic actions given the board upheaval.
